summary.text: Roy Surrett is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 2 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Norman Sanderson (R).
He has nearly 40 years of federal government experience, including work as a national security expert with the U.S. Department of Defense, according to his Ballotpedia survey responses.

paragraphs.text: Roy Surrett graduated from North Penn High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Wake Forest University in 1985 and a graduate degree from the University of South Carolina in 1988.
His career experience includes working in government.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Surrett said he is a resident of Carteret County and has organized local philanthropic campaigns, including "7 Weeks of Giving."
Surrett advanced to the general election after the Democratic primary was canceled.
In the survey, he named public education, lower costs and resilient communities, and dependable, affordable health care as his key messages.
He said he would work to fully fund public schools, secure competitive teacher pay, expand vocational training and expand health services in rural areas.
